# Harvard Business Review

> > Harvard Business Review provides research-backed insights, case studies, and practical advice on leadership, strategy, and management for business executives and leaders worldwide.

HBR is a leading source of business thought leadership, publishing articles, podcasts, and research from academics and practitioners on topics ranging from AI transformation and organizational excellence to employee development and strategic management. The site also offers custom business simulations and assessments for executive training and MBA education.

## Key Topics

- Business Leadership
- AI Transformation
- C-Suite Management
- Employee Development
- Strategic Project Management
- Organizational Excellence
- Executive Insights
- Workplace Productivity
- Business Simulations
- Experiential Learning
- Leadership Training
- Supply Chain Management
- Negotiation Training
- MBA Education

## Core Resources

- [Harvard Business Review - Ideas and Advice for Leaders](https://hbr.org/): Main homepage featuring leadership insights, business strategy articles, and research-backed management advice

## Training and Simulations

- [Custom Simulations for Training and Higher Education](https://assessments.hbr.org/): Business simulations platform for executive training, leadership development, and MBA education programs
